question: How many measurement divisions apply to two-or-three-hall buildings up to eighteen cubits?
premises: Measurements extend up to nineteen cubits less one.
The division applies to two-or-three-hall buildings.
inference: Two-or-three-hall buildings have seven measurement divisions up to eighteen cubits.
plain_english: For two-or-three-hall buildings, the measures up to eighteen cubits are divided sevenfold.
